historical_row.subject: lem-characteristic-period-annulus-has-an-orbit-or-polycycle-frontier
historical_row.description: Proof step 8.1 treated only a decreasing radial coordinate although the collar field may have either nonzero sign.
historical_row.repair: A fixed nonzero sign of Xr does not imply decay when Xr>0. If a periodic orbit meets r<δ, its compact radial coordinate has a minimum there and derivative Xr=0, contradicting |Xr|≥k regardless of sign. Step 8.1 now gives this complete argument. The theorem's conclusion and consumer hypotheses are unchanged.

historical_row.subject: codimension-one-foliations-and-secondary-classes-examples
historical_row.description: False equivalence between a solid torus and a closed-torus mapping torus in the examples-page summary.
historical_row.repair: The current pre-repair summary equated D2×S1 with a mapping torus of a closed-torus diffeomorphism. The former has nonempty boundary T2; the latter is closed, as also explicitly stated by the opened mapping-torus supplier. Boundary is a homeomorphism invariant, so the equivalence is false. Replaced the draft summary with the actual connected-fibre circle-bundle example and closed-surface mapping tori as particular examples, plus the explicit rescaling calculation. Both assigned examples and the entire current page were reviewed. No published carrier changed.
